claims.citation: New York Herald, 5 May 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship William Penn (Br), Billinge, London April 10
via Havre 15th and St Johns, NF, 29th, with mdse and 684
passengers, to Howland & Aspinwall. Saw an immense
quantity of ice in berg and field; all to the northward of Cape
Race; April 20, lat 49 25, lon 24 52, passed bark Lady Gordon
(Br), standing S; May 3, 10 AM, passed steamship Persia, off
Nantucket.
